posting_text: Staff Platform Engineer. We are 34 engineers running a fleet-coordination service on Go, Kubernetes and Kafka; the hard problem is exactly-once task dispatch across regions, which we have not solved yet. The posting exists because our v1 scheduler stalls above 40k concurrent jobs and enterprise pilots are blocked on it. You would own that migration end to end and report directly to the CTO, who still reviews production code every week. Fully remote across EU and US time zones.

Senior Data Engineer. Northwind is a 900-person analytics consultancy. We are hiring to expand our reporting practice. Requirements: SQL, Power BI, stakeholder management. Our delivery teams work on client sites and we ask for 4 days per week in the Chicago office. This role supports account managers with dashboard requests and is measured on utilization.

Founding Infrastructure Engineer (first 10 hires). Latchkey builds durable execution for payment workflows: Postgres, Rust, and a homegrown lease-based queue. The immediate task is moving off a single-node cron runner after a November incident where retried transfers double-posted. The founders are ex-Stripe engineers who still run the on-call rotation. Remote-first with quarterly onsites.

We are building the leading AI-powered content platform. Our product wraps a frontier model with a Playwright browser agent and a thin prompt layer. Looking for a Senior Engineer to join our fast-paced growth team. In-office 5 days in Austin. We move fast and ship daily.

Principal Engineer, Event Streaming. Orbital moves freight documentation for 3 of the top 10 logistics carriers. Our backbone is Kafka plus a Flink job graph doing exactly-once enrichment, with a Postgres ledger of record. The mandate for this role is replacing a brittle nightly batch reconciliation that loses carrier events under backpressure, which is currently a contractual escalation. Leadership is technical: the VP Engineering owns the streaming roadmap and writes design docs. Hybrid, 1 day per week in Rotterdam.

Backend Developer, contract to hire. Vellum provides HR onboarding paperwork automation. We need someone to add API endpoints to our Django app and help with ticket backlog. Team of 6, close to the founders. Office in Manchester, flexible hours, occasional remote days possible.
